Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى سِتْرِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ
Translation: O Allah, praise be to You for Your concealment despite Your knowledge
And for Your protection despite Your awareness

Arabic text: فَكُلُّنَا قَدِ اقْتَرَفَ الْعَائِبَةَ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْهُ
Translation: For each of us has committed faults, yet You did not expose us
And committed indecencies, yet You did not disgrace us
And concealed our evils, yet You did not point them out
How many of Your prohibitions have we violated
And commands have You established for us, yet we transgressed them
And sins have we acquired, and mistakes have we committed
You were the One aware of them, not other observers
And capable of revealing them, above all others with power

Arabic text: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لَنَا حِجَابًا دُوْنَ أَبْصَارِهِمْ
Translation: Your protection for us was a veil before their eyes
And a barrier before their ears
So make what You have concealed of our defects
And hidden of our inner faults a lesson for us

Arabic text: وَزَاجِرًا عَنْ سُوءِ الْخُلُقِ وَاقْتِرَافِ الْخَطِيئَةِ
Translation: And a deterrent from bad character and committing sins

Arabic text: وَسَعْيًا إِلَى التَّوْبَةِ الْمَاحِيَةِ وَالطَّرِيقِ الْمَحْمُودَةِ
Translation: And a striving toward erasable repentance and the praiseworthy path
And bring near its time
And do not mark us with heedlessness of You

Arabic text: إِنَّا إِلَيْكَ رَاغِبُونَ، وَمِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَائِبُونَ
Translation: Indeed, we are desirous of You, and repentant from sins

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى خِيَرَتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And send blessings upon Your chosen one from Your creation

Arabic text: مُحَمَّدٍ وَعِتْرَتِهِ الصِّفْوَةِ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: Muhammad and his pure family, the chosen ones from Your creation, the purified

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَامِعِينَ وَمُطِيعِينَ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ
Translation: And make us among those who listen to them and obey them as You have commanded
